rules.message: That slot is full for your party size.
rules.check: const n = Number(row.party_size); if (!(n >= 1 && n <= 10)) return 'Parties are 1 to 10 guests.'; const s = await ctx.db.query('select capacity from slot where id = $1', [row.slot_id]); const sr = Array.isArray(s) ? s : (s as any).rows; const cap = Number(sr && sr[0] ? sr[0].capacity : 0); const l = await ctx.db.query('select coalesce(sum(seats),0) as t from slot_load where slot_id = $1 and date = $2', [row.slot_id, row.date]); const lr = Array.isArray(l) ? l : (l as any).rows; const taken = Number(lr && lr[0] ? lr[0].t : 0); if (taken + n > cap) return 'Only ' + Math.max(0, cap - taken) + ' seats left in that slot.'; return true;

do.code: const rows = await ctx.db.list('slot_load'); const hit = rows.find((r) => String(r.slot_id) === String(row.slot_id) && String(r.date).slice(0, 10) === String(row.date).slice(0, 10)); const n = Number(row.party_size) || 0; if (hit) { await ctx.db.update('slot_load', String(hit.id), { seats: Number(hit.seats) + n }); } else { await ctx.db.create('slot_load', { slot_id: row.slot_id, date: String(row.date).slice(0, 10), seats: n }); }

const rows = await ctx.db.list('slot_load'); const hit = rows.find((r) => String(r.slot_id) === String(row.slot_id) && String(r.date).slice(0, 10) === String(row.date).slice(0, 10)); if (hit) { await ctx.db.update('slot_load', String(hit.id), { seats: Math.max(0, Number(hit.seats) - (Number(row.party_size) || 0)) }); }

const now = ctx.now().getTime(); const rows = await ctx.db.list('booking'); let n = 0; for (const b of rows) { if (String(b.status) !== 'booked') continue; const t = new Date(String(b.starts_at)).getTime(); if (t + 30 * 60000 < now) { await ctx.db.update('booking', String(b.id), { status: 'no_show' }); n++; } } ctx.log('marked no-show: ' + n);
